visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins on a stark white background featuring Bugcat Capoo, a blue cat-bug hybrid, nestled inside a large orange fruit decorated with a red 'good luck' diamond. A stylized white snake is coiled around the base of the orange. Golden nuggets float and rotate in the air. (2) The scene transitions to Capoo wearing a small red cap and jumping energetically with the white snake riding on its back. Gold coins with square holes and golden nuggets bounce around them. (3) A sequence of fast-paced cuts shows Capoo and the snake in various festive scenarios: holding a red envelope with a 'Spring' character, appearing in a repeating pattern with oranges on their heads, and Capoo jumping with joy while coins fly out of a red pouch. (4) The final phase presents a comprehensive grid layout showcasing various sticker designs featuring the characters in different comedic and celebratory poses, including Capoo throwing money and wearing sunglasses, all organized under a promotional header.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-tempo, bright, and cheerful electronic BGM starts immediately, featuring a square-wave synthesizer melody and a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. The atmosphere is festive and high-energy. No vocals are present. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs, synchronized with a visual movement. The BGM maintains its tempo and happy major-key tonality. The acoustic environment is pristinely clean, typical of a digital studio production. (3) A series of metallic 'ding' sounds and cartoonish bubble pops are layered over the continuous BGM loop. The music remains the primary focus, driving the upbeat rhythm of the video until a final stinger chord ends the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a high-energy promotional showcase for the 'Bugcat Capoo' Year of the Snake digital sticker set on the LINE messaging platform. It utilizes fast-paced animation and festive Chinese New Year themes to grab attention and demonstrate the various sticker designs available for purchase.
